added_failures_note: unmeasured as an armed suite pair: the reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite, and its gate-final.log is the legibility check rather than a pytest run, so 0 records the absence of an armed suite rather than a measured zero added failures.

assertion_audit.fails_when: Restoring the single 3.0 pt solved stroke draws the nine levels into a band; measure() counts 7254 fused pixels and main() raises CONTOURS FUSED at EXIT=1, as legibility-negative-control.log records.

If solved_level_widths returned SOLVED_FLUX_WIDTH for every level the SVG would carry nine 3.0 pt strokes; nothing in the repository asserts the emitted widths, so only the run-directory gate catches this regression.
assertion_audit.limit: No test collects the check; the guard lives as a script in the run directory and its red run is a log, not a suite entry.

assertion_audit.fails_when: It cannot fail on its own subject: the mask compares against a hard-coded SOLVED_FLUX, and changing nova/media/ink.py:45 flux_color would zero solved_pixels and fused_pixels and print CONTOURS LEGIBLE.

figure_review.result: Viewed the head-rasterised trip-2 panel and the reverted-drawing control side by side: at the base the nine blue levels fuse into a solid block above the limiter and along the bottom edge, carrying no level information; at the head every level is separable in both regions, the legend sits above with no undrawn entry, no label collides or leaves the canvas, and the plasma sits inside the limiter.

findings.text: the three svg pointers were rewritten from repository-relative docs/figures paths to absolute run-directory paths under .config/reckon/crew/runs/.../rendered/adaptive, which resolve for no other reader and will die with the run directory; render_trip_panels.py:720 records str(out), so rendering into run scratch bakes a transient path into a committed artefact.

the check prints CONTOURS LEGIBLE whenever no fused pixels are counted and never asserts solved_pixels > 0, while its mask at line 62 matches a hard-coded SOLVED_FLUX rather than nova/media/ink.py:45 flux_color, so a change to the flux colour empties the mask and the guard reports legibility it has not measured.

the legend's solved-flux handle is drawn at SOLVED_FLUX_WIDTH 3.0 pt while the levels it names are 0.7-1.21 pt on frame 146 trip 2, so the sample overstates the stroke by up to four times, against the rule that a legend entry be as thick as the line it names.

axes.set_aspect("equal") repeats what poloidal_axes already did at nova/media/ink.py:164 on the preceding line; the set_xlim/set_ylim that follow it are load-bearing for the display-space spacing measured at line 480, but the aspect line itself is redundant.
